definition: Pillow is the standard Python library for opening, editing and saving images.
details: A friendly fork of the Python Imaging Library (PIL), started by Jeffrey “Alex” Clark in 2010 and maintained by the Pillow team.

explainer.lead: How to install Pillow, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Alex Clark and contributors (fork of PIL by Fredrik Lundh).

quickstart.python:
from PIL import Image, ImageOps

img = Image.open("photo.jpg").convert("RGB")
thumb = ImageOps.fit(img, (224, 224))
thumb.save("thumb.png")
print(img.size, img.mode)

explainer.inAi: Most vision models (CLIP, ViT, diffusion pipelines) take or return PIL images.
explainer.jsNote: Python only. In Node, sharp is the common image-processing library.
